page.layout: One page of text, all full width. Top: decorative printed border, then a large title block in capitals and italic lines, centred. Below it a signed dedication line. Lower down a paragraph opening with a decorated initial.

main_text.head: ILLVSTRISSIMIS, REVERENDISSIMIS, HEROICAEQ[?] VIRTUTIS PPr.ac DDn. Dn. FRIDERICO junior. Comiti Palatino Rheni, Vtriusq[?] Bavariae Duci, &c. Nec non Dn. OTTHONI Hassiae Landgravio, &c. Postulato Administratori Hirsfeldensi:

p.i: DDn. & Mecaenatibus suis clementissimis, hunc de vita bene ac salubriter prorogandA, tractatum, debita observantia, officii, subiectionis ergo, humilima manu offert, dedicat, consecrat,

page.notes: The title block is set in large roman capitals with mixed italic and black letter-style abbreviations. "HEROICAEQ" is printed with a ligature-like q (cæq̃ with a suspended stroke); reading is uncertain. "Vtriusq" is printed with a q-suspension mark. Line "Anitatem" is the decorated initial S with the first word split by the initial; the S is a woodcut initial and the word reads "SANITATEM", printed as "Anitatem" beside it. The final line "mum" is shown with a catchword-like fragment ")( 2" at the foot, which is a signature mark. The top border is a decorative woodcut ornament, not text. The word "prorogandA" ends with a capital A printed in the scan; it is read as printed with [?]. Title: layout partly inferred from the image; the words "Dn. FRIDERICO" appear in decorative black letter and are transcribed in roman as the closest reading. Catchword not present; signature mark ")( 2" at foot is a gathering signature.
